text: I spent so long, trying not to burn. Another asked what the fire made. I remember every match, every door I couldn't close Every night I called it love just because it hurt the most Someone finally drew a line, someone left a little light I learned how to make my own without setting fire to the night Ya no busco cicatrices para sentir que sigo aquí I can't hear an empty room now without needing it to bleed All that heat I used to fear, I can finally fucking hold Maybe I was never ruined, maybe I was being forced No soy ceniza, I'm not what burned away No soy el fuego, I'm what the fire changed Forged above gold, I came through the flame Not the man that walked in, not ashamed of what changed Forged above gold, mas fue decair I don't need another wound, just to know that I am here Let the old fire go Let the new blood run cold I wasn't made to burn forever I was forced above gold There was a time I begged somebody Hurt me if you're gonna stay Now I know love doesn't hold me Blood to prove it feels the same Vi la luz quedar sin encendida Cuando tuve que caminar Then I stood beside the fire And watch the water make it calm Nobody saved me, that's the beautiful part Nobody carried me out of the dark Aprendí a encender mi luz, aprendí también a parar Now I know the difference between a flame and a scar Patience, mommy Yeah I know I know No tienes que arder para sentir calor You don't have to break to deserve someone's love Lo que sobrevivió ya no pide perdón I thought surviving meant becoming stone It means knowing when to let the fire go Forged above gold We came through the flame Not untouched, not unchanged, not ashamed Forged above gold Más fuerte que ayer No more begging for the burn Just to know somebody's there I can stand in the quiet Yo me puedo quedar I can carry my own fate Sin tenerte que salvar Let the old fire go There is nothing left to prove We were made to burn forever We were forged The fire didn't make me gold It taught me I was worth more My skewered up, forged above cold
